status_definitions.ALREADY HANDLED: Applied, contacted, rejected, replied, or in an active process. Do not duplicate without an explicit history review.
status_definitions.INTERNATIONAL - READY: Passes current speculative governance, history clear, current recipient and verified direct professional email available.
status_definitions.INTERNATIONAL - NEEDS CONTACT: Company passes current speculative governance but current named recipient/direct professional email still needs verification.
status_definitions.INTERNATIONAL - HOLD: Internationally plausible but has a material specialist, language, size, autonomy, role-evidence, or other governance concern.
status_definitions.NATIONAL / NORDIC ONLY: No genuine wider international commercial remit verified for Andrew's current objective.
status_definitions.IRRELEVANT / EXCLUDED: Fails a hard gate or is outside the target commercial profile.
status_definitions.NEEDS LIVE REVIEW: Not yet fully checked against current company evidence, GitHub history and Gmail history.

operating_rule: Process each source row once in source order. Treat the ordered union in data/speculative-company-audit-index.json as the canonical audit ledger. Save new work in small non-overlapping append-only block files, add each committed block to the index, and only then advance this cursor. For any potentially viable international company, complete live GitHub and Gmail history checks before INTERNATIONAL - READY or INTERNATIONAL - NEEDS CONTACT. Never infer unsent from absence in an old target queue. Never rescan an indexed source row unless Andrew explicitly requests a re-audit.
